headline: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) Stock May Be 36% Undervalued After Raised Outlook
summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland has delivered a 45.2% total return over the past five years, yet its current share price sits between two conflicting signals, with an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model pointing to upside while earnings-based multiples look less generous. Over five years, a 45.2% return suggests Archer-Daniels-Midland has rewarded patient shareholders but not in a way that clearly settles whether the stock is now cheap or fully priced. Recent news...
